test.create_query: CREATE TABLE hex_mixed (h String) ENGINE = Memory
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO hex_mixed SELECT hex(randomString(number % 41)) FROM numbers(5_000_000)
test.query: SELECT count() FROM numbers(10_000_000) WHERE NOT ignore(hex(materialize(repeat('J', 8))))
